scientific.integrity: The proof is field-independent and algebraic. A standalone checker verifies the finite parity count and closed form for a broad grid of small parameters; it is supportive rather than a substitute for the proof.
scientific.limitations: Characteristic 2 is excluded. The result concerns multilinear graded codimensions for the fine grading only, not non-multilinear finite-field identities or the scalar/classical gradings.

title: Exact graded codimensions for the fine grading of a bilinear-form Jordan algebra
